rating_policy.substantial: Multiple inspected and independently considered source passages; coherent sequence, physical anchor and uncertainty bounded sufficiently for detailed draft, editorial review still separate
rating_policy.developing: Substantive but incomplete explanation with source-located evidence and critical remaining gaps
rating_policy.sparse: Metadata, single abbreviated excerpt or insufficient physical explanation; not visitor-ready
rating_policy.missing: No examined substantive event explanation; bibliographic lead alone does not populate cell
